text: Good afternoon. I'm calling this session of appeals to order at 2:31. Is there a motion to convene a closed meeting? Yes, Madam Chair. I move that the Loudoun County School Board recess this public meeting and enter into a closed meeting pursuant to Section 2.2-3712 of the Code of Virginia for the

following purposes: discussion or consideration of matters that would involve the disclosure of information contained in respective scholastic records concerning students, namely parents requesting permission by staff for their respective students to be accepted or given early attendance at an existing school, but who missed the survey deadline as authorized by Section 2.2-3711, Section A, Section 2 of the Code of Virginia. Is there a second for that motion?

Second. Thank you, Ms. Chandler. The motion has been properly seconded. All in favor, please say aye. Aye. Aye. Opposed? Hearing no opposition, we are now in closed session. Having completed all our business, is there a motion to adjourn the closed meeting? Yes, Madam Chair. I move that the closed meeting be adjourned, that the Loudoun County School Board

reconvene its public meeting, and that the minutes of the public meeting reflect that no formal action was taken in the closed meeting. Is there a second? Second. Thank you, Ms. Chandler. There has been a motion made to close the meeting, adjourn the closed meeting, I'm sorry, and it has been properly seconded. All those in favor, say aye. Aye. Aye. Opposed? Hearing no opposition, we will now adjourn the closed meeting. Is there a motion to certify the closed meeting?

Yes, Madam Chair. Thank you, Mr. Pepper. I move that the following resolution certifying the closed meeting be adopted and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting. Is there- Resolution number 30-25/26. Whereas the Loudoun County School Board has convened a closed meeting on this date pursuant to an affirmative recorded vote and in accordance with the provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act, and whereas Section 2.2-3712D of the Code of Virginia requires

a certification by the school board that such closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law. Now therefore, be it resolved that the Loudoun County School Board hereby certifies that, to the best of each member's knowledge: one, only public business matters lawfully exempted from open meeting requirements by Virginia law were discussed in the closed meeting to which this certification applies. And two, only such public business matters as were identified in the motion convening the closed meetings were heard, discussed, or considered by the Loudoun County School Board.

Is there a second? Second. Thank you, Ms. Chandler. The motion has been moved and seconded. All those in favor, say aye. Aye. Aye. All those opposed? Hearing no opposition, we will go on. Is there a motion to accept the findings that we put forward in this meeting? Yes, Madam Chair. Thank you, Mr. Pepper. I move that the select committee of the school board's findings and decisions

included in the attached table be adopted and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting. Is there a second? Second. Thank you, Ms. Chandler. There's a motion on the floor to approve the findings and decisions in this meeting. All those in favor say aye. Aye. Aye. All those opposed, nay. Hearing no opposition, this motion passes.
